title: Wholemeal spaghetti with garlic prawns and cherry tomatoes
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, keeping some of the cooking water.
Slice the garlic and fry it gently with the chilli flakes in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and fry for 2 minutes, then add the halved tomatoes for 2 more minutes.
Toss in the spaghetti with a little cooking water, lemon juice and parsley and serve with rocket.
